title: Bounded redacted diagnostics for direct E2E phase tests

phases.objective: Place the first failing direct E2E test's bounded redacted stdout and stderr inside the canonical execution artifact so Job logs are not required for ordinary diagnosis.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A direct phase test exits non-zero after writing stdout and secret-like stderr
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The execution report preserves the exit code and includes bounded redacted diagnostic streams without exposing the secret-like value.
steps: Execute the direct phase test with captured stdout and stderr.
Echo only redacted output when the test fails.
Store bounded diagnostic stream metadata and tails on the failed result.
Mark Job logs as diagnostic-only in the execution report.
assertions: The original non-zero exit code is preserved.
The secret-like diagnostic value is removed.
The diagnostic tail is bounded to the shared maximum.
The report itself contains enough evidence for normal root-cause triage.

phases.objective: Surface the first bounded direct-test diagnostic in the PR evidence comment.
Exercise spawn errors, invalid UTF-8, oversized dual streams, and diagnostic helper failure.
Observe direct E2E failure reports across representative repository workflows.
Require bounded diagnostics for every direct E2E failure before protected-branch merge readiness.
